name: Do Unto Others
overview: The Scriptures call believers to a Christ-centered ethic of interpersonal conduct, emphasizing love and fairness. Leviticus 19:18 and Mark 12:31 highlight the command to love one’s neighbor as oneself, underscoring its supreme importance. Jesus reinforces this principle in the Sermon on the Mount, instructing His followers not to judge others (Matthew 7:1) and to treat others as they themselves would want to be treated (Matthew 7:12; Luke 6:31). Proverbs 28:6 contrasts uprightness with worldly wealth, affirming that integrity in relationships matters more than riches.
